Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal candidate art for achievement_medal_travel_tier_001, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Primary request: Create one absurd but very simple premium collectible travel achievement medal for the Chinese achievement title concept "穷人乍富" (suddenly rich after being poor). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a simple chunky beveled gold rim and one clean turquoise enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold travel suitcase wearing oversized cheap black sunglasses, as if the suitcase suddenly became rich and went traveling. The suitcase is closed or only barely cracked open; no objects spill out. Add only one or two large star-shaped glints as lighting, not separate items.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, playful deliberate nonsense, premium material finish, strong beveled relief, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: very simple, large readable silhouette, suitcase centered and dominant. No ticket card, no gold bricks, no coins, no coin pile, no confetti rain, no extra props. Keep the medal low-detail enough for future tiers to become more elaborate.
Lighting/mood: bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, intentionally over-serious luxury applied to a dumb joke.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold, electric turquoise enamel, small coral accent only on the rim, black sunglasses, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, beveled rim, subtle hand-painted shading. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no gold bar, no gold brick, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
